verdict.rationale: Box documents Collaborations as ACL-like, role-based access grants for users and groups on both files and folders (box-docs-4, box-docs-21, box-docs-37). Shared links also offer configurable access levels (box-docs-36), and a community user praises selectively granting outside parties access to files and folders (box-comm-9). However, the pack never lists the specific roles or describes how permissions inherit down folder trees. Missing for 10: an enumerated role set (viewer/commenter/editor/owner equivalents), documented inheritance behavior for folder-to-subfolder/file permissions, and hands-on corroboration of granular role behavior.
